**Fixed**

- Forced subtitles clear when their display period ends instead of remaining until the next subtitle.
- PGS subtitle clear events retain their timestamps during FFmpeg remuxing. Please make a fresh rip to validate the fix on previously affected discs (#52).
- Improved audio frame assembly, transport audio discovery and preservation of opening audio and MKV timing metadata.

**Quality checks**

- Added FFmpeg QA checks for subtitle clearing, decoded audio/video content and synchronization.
- Simplified developer comments and documentation, with shared CI checks to prevent comment overflow.

_This release aligns all components to 1.7.7._
